title: Disney Orders Aquamarine Series With Returning Film Stars
excerpt:
Emma Roberts and Jake McDorman reprise their original roles.
The series is headed to Disney+ and Disney Channel.
body_md:
Following a pilot order in June 2026, Disney has picked up a series based on the 2006 film Aquamarine. Kenzi Richardson leads the cast as Coral, alongside Briella Guiza, Theodore Dalton and Annika Reese.

Coral moves to a seaside town and investigates her mother's disappearance. Discovering that her mother is a mermaid awakens her own magical abilities as secrets beneath the waves begin to emerge.

Emma Roberts and Jake McDorman return as Claire and Raymond and will executive produce. Original director Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum directs the pilot, while original producer Susan Cartsonis also returns. Sarah Watson wrote the pilot and executive produces.

Loosely adapted from Alice Hoffman's novel, the original film starred Roberts, Joanna JoJo Levesque and Sara Paxton. It followed two teenage friends who encounter a mermaid and help her explore the possibility of true love.

Disney emphasizes friendship, self-discovery and confidence as central themes of the new series. A premiere date has not been announced.
seo_description: Emma Roberts and Jake McDorman return for Disney's Aquamarine series.
